name: ControlAppliance.execute
description: Controls a home appliance, checks its current status and settings, and monitors indoor air properties such as air quality and temperature. The command must be explicit, using 'power on' or 'start' for control actions and 'check' for status inquiries. Mode or routine management is not supported by this function.

command.description: The operation command for an appliance, optionally preceded by a room name and followed by the appliance name or alias. The command should be separated by commas. For example, 'main room, air conditioner, turn on' to power on the air conditioner in the main room, 'None, air conditioner, cool' to set the air conditioner to cool mode without specifying a room, and 'laundry room, tongdonly, stop' to stop the tongdonly appliance in the laundry room.

name: ControlAppliance.execute
description: This function is designed for controlling a home appliance, checking its current status and settings, as well as monitoring indoor air properties like air quality and temperature. For control commands, the input must clearly specify 'power on' or 'start'. To check the status, the input must include the keyword '확인'. Note that this tool is not intended for describing, creating, deleting, or removing modes or routines.

command.description: The command must be specified as a string in Korean, consisting of the room name, appliance name (or alias), and operation command, separated by commas. Examples: '거실, 에어컨, 실행' for turning on the air conditioner in the living room, ', 에어컨, 냉방 실행' for activating cooling without specifying the room, '다용도실, 통돌이, 중지' for stopping the washing machine (alias '통돌이') in the utility room.

name.description: The name for the website alert configuration.

description.description: A brief description of the website alert configuration.

severity.description: The severity level of the alert when triggered. Can be either 5 for a Warning or 10 for Critical.

triggering.description: A flag indicating whether an Incident is also triggered when the alert is triggered.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website for which the alert configuration is created.

tagFilterExpression.description: A boolean expression of tag filters used to define the scope of relevant website beacons.

granularity.description: The evaluation granularity in minutes, defining the size of the tumbling window used for detection of threshold violations.

rule.description: The type of rule this alert configuration represents, such as 'traffic spike' or 'downtime'.

threshold.description: The value of the threshold this alert rule is evaluated against.

timeThreshold.description: The time period in minutes for which the threshold must be violated to trigger the alert.

alertChannelIds.description: A list of unique identifiers for alert channels defined in Instana to which the alert notifications will be sent.

name: EventSettingsApi.get_alerting_channel
description: Retrieve the configuration details of a specific alerting channel by its identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the alerting channel.

name: EventSettingsApi.get_built_in_event_specifications
description: Retrieve a list of built-in event specifications using their IDs.

ids.description: A list of event specification IDs to retrieve. Each ID is a string uniquely identifying an event specification.

name: EventSettingsApi.get_custom_event_specification
description: Retrieve the details of a custom event specification using its unique identifier.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the custom event specification.

name: EventSettingsApi.get_custom_event_specification
description: Retrieve the specifications for a custom event by its unique identifier.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the custom event specification.

name: EventSettingsApi.get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications using their unique identifiers.

event_ids.description: An array of event specification identifiers to fetch details for.

include_details.description: Flag to determine whether to include detailed information for each event specification.

name: EventSettingsApi.restore_mobile_app_alert_config
description: Restores the configuration of mobile app alerts to a previous state using the specified ID. This can be used to revert changes or recover a configuration that was mistakenly altered.

id.description: The unique identifier of the mobile app alert configuration to be restored.

created.description: The creation timestamp of the alert configuration in the format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'.

name: events_api.EventsApi.agent_monitoring_events
description: Retrieves all agent monitoring events within a specified timeframe. It allows for querying historical events and can filter events based on their state updates. Users can define the timeframe using 'to', 'from', and 'windowSize' parameters.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp in seconds. If not provided, defaults to the current service time.

_from.description: The start of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp in seconds, defining a range [from, to). This is an alternative to 'windowSize'. If neither 'from' nor 'windowSize' is provided, defaults to 10 minutes before the 'to' timestamp.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds, relative to the 'to' parameter. If neither 'windowSize' nor 'from' is provided, defaults to 600000 milliseconds (10 minutes).

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: Excludes events triggered before the requested timeframe. Useful for integrations that require only new events starting within the timeframe.

filterEventUpdates.description: Filters the results to include only event updates. Events are included only if their state changed within the requested timeframe. Suitable for integrations that are interested in event state updates.

name: events_api.EventsApi.get_events
description: Retrieves all available events for a given timeframe. It allows for different query options such as excluding events triggered before the timeframe or filtering for event updates only.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the current service time if not provided.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds relative to 'to'. Defaults to 600000 milliseconds (10 minutes) if not provided.

_from.description: Alternative to 'windowSize', defines the start of the timeframe in Unix timestamp format. The query spans the range ['from', 'to').

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: Exclude events that were triggered before the requested timeframe. Useful for batch jobs that only care about new events. Defaults to 'false'.

filterEventUpdates.description: Filters results to event updates that occurred within the query timeframe. Defaults to 'false'.

includeAgentMonitoringIssues.description: Include Agent Monitoring Issues in the results. This parameter is deprecated. Defaults to 'false'.

includeKubernetesInfoEvents.description: Include Kubernetes Info Events in the results. This parameter is deprecated. Defaults to 'false'.

eventTypeFilters.description: Filters events by type. Acceptable values are 'INFO', 'WARN', and 'ERROR'.

name: events_api.EventsApi.get_events
description: This endpoint retrieves all available events for the requested timeframe, including options to filter by event type and to exclude or include specific event updates.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp in seconds. If not provided, it defaults to the current service time.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds relative to the 'to' parameter. If neither 'windowSize' nor 'from' is provided, it defaults to 600000 milliseconds (10 minutes).

_from.description: The start of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp in seconds. It defines the timeframe range [from, to). If not provided, it defaults to 'to' - 'windowSize'.

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: Whether to exclude events that were triggered before the requested timeframe. Useful for integrations that only care about new events within a fixed interval.

filterEventUpdates.description: Filters results to event updates only, including events that changed state within the given query timeframe.

includeAgentMonitoringIssues.description: Flag to indicate whether to include Agent Monitoring Issues in the results. This is deprecated and defaults to false.

includeKubernetesInfoEvents.description: Flag to indicate whether to include Kubernetes Info Events in the results. This is deprecated and defaults to false.

eventTypeFilters.description: A comma-separated list of event type filters to apply to the query, allowing for specific types of events to be fetched. If not provided, no filtering is applied.

name: events_api.EventsApi.kubernetes_info_events
description: Retrieve all Kubernetes info events within the specified timeframe. Events can be filtered to show only updates or exclude events triggered before the timeframe. Suitable for 3rd party integrations fetching events in scheduled batches.

to.description: The end of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp.

windowSize.description: The size of the requested timeframe in milliseconds relative to 'to'. Defaults to 10 minutes (600,000 milliseconds) if neither 'windowSize' nor 'from' is provided.

_from.description: The start of the requested timeframe as a Unix timestamp, defining the range [from, to). Optional. If not provided, defaults to 'to' minus 'windowSize'.

excludeTriggeredBefore.description: Exclude events that were triggered before the requested timeframe. Useful for only searching events that started within the given timeframe. Defaults to false.

filterEventUpdates.description: Filter results to only include event updates that occurred within the given timeframe. Defaults to false.
